parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of wood, forming the front movable panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space by opening and closing, often attached with hinges and a handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open or close the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing support and shape.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including the door and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is the internal shelf made of wood, positioned horizontally inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a flat surface for storing or organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during regular use.
